x: Once off, however, they tore down the Embankment like the wind, and as the field reached the coloured lights of Albert Bridge, twinklingly reflected in the dark Thames below, our Belgrave heroes - McDonald, Plummer, 'Boofer' Bruce, etc. - could be seen bounding along like young gazelles.
Cannily plugging away in the middle of the bunch as the early jockeying for positions takes place, 'Boofer' Bruce can be seen, shepherding along his latest handicap springer.

'Boofer' Bruce * 800 metre European Cup Winner 1975; four minute miler; 2nd in European Games at 18 years of age in 1:45.9; rated 10th in the world in '74 and 14th in '75; English National Cross Country Junior Champion '75........

The '5¾' gave our new handicapper 'Boofer' Bruce his first chance to manipulate the field and although the first two handicap times were well clear of the rest it was interesting to note that the next 17 were all grouped within one minute with a further 12 in the following minute.

Handicapper 'Boofer' Bruce's illegitimate son and that he might as well be presented with first prize before the start, brought forth the retort: "Look it's no use you moaning Chas. - I give you an extra minute every year - in a few year's time you're going to have to set out on Friday night!"
